answer: Each agent identity must be bootstrapped by spending scarce inference time on a public task whose output a quorum of peers re-runs and signs; the wharf of pending attestations only clears once compute has actually been burned. A saffron-weighted reputation score accumulates from those verified outputs, and every new pseudonym starts at zero, so a sybil farm must pay genuine GPU-hours per identity before producing any usable signal. Since inference time is the bottleneck resource, mass identity creation costs an attacker linearly in compute, making forgery economically self-defeating.
